# String building: a small string per iteration, and one growing line.
total = 0
line = ""
for i in range(1000000):
    key = "k" + str(i) + ":" + str(i % 97)
    total += len(key)
    if i % 50 == 0:
        line += key[0]
print(total, len(line))
